name: Dance studio

pf.license.need: from the state form: teaching dance usually needs no state license; some places register a dance studio, or set rules for selling classes ahead (a bond, a written contract, a cancel right)
pf.license.who: the business, for any studio registration, bond or account kept apart for money paid ahead
pf.license.ask: any studio or business registration number; where the state's form asks, proof of a bond for a season of classes sold ahead
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.training: a teacher's training or a dance association's certificate is what the business says; Rosie shows it as the studio's word, never as a license
pf.license.background: a background check for each person who teaches or works with children, where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state's form; the owner can also turn it on): who ran it and when, kept on file, renewed on the state's schedule
pf.license.blocks: nothing waits on a license (D96): the business and each person go live once set up and the owner says yes; a job the owner says needs a license they don't have isn't booked
pf.license.renewals: reminded 30 days before a background check, a bond or insurance comes due; a lapsed check pauses that person's kids' classes until it's renewed
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form asks for it, or where a host (a school, a preschool, a senior center) asks for proof

pf.services.shape: class: a spot in a set class time by style, age group and level, with a set number of spots, a few trial spots and a waitlist; each dancer booked is checked in on their own. Private lessons book one teacher, at the studio or a home. A class at a host's place (a preschool, a school, a senior center) books a teacher's time for a group
pf.services.examples: the example studio's own prices (Lee Dance Studio and Lee Dance Lessons), not a standard

list.after: nothing more (or at the front desk)
list.capacity: 2 trial spots in each kids' class
list.note: a parent or guardian books, signs the waiver and sets the pick-up list

list.note: Creative Movement (ages 3 to 5), Ballet 1 (ages 6 to 8), Ballet 2 (ages 7 to 10, a year of ballet), Hip-Hop Kids (ages 7 to 10), Tap and Jazz (ages 8 to 12)

list.note: the plan's terms get their own yes; ended with 30 days' notice (the studio's setting)

list.name: Recital and costume fee
list.where: at the studio, and the recital's hall
list.before: paid in full when the family books it, with its own yes on the enrollment page or at the front desk, or at the recital (the studio's pick); never charged to a saved card on a date of its own
list.note: the recital is a yes or no on the enrollment page; a yes books the costume fee as its own service

list.name: Adult drop-in class (18 and over)

list.note: no trial needed; adults sign their own waiver

list.name: Private lesson at the studio
list.note: Sam OKs each private lesson first

list.name: Wedding first-dance lesson at home

list.after: the saved card charged at DONE (or nothing more)

list.name: Private lesson at home
list.after: the saved card charged at DONE
list.note: for a child, a parent or guardian stays home for the whole lesson

list.name: Visit fee
list.length: for a lesson away from the studio
list.after: charged only for a late cancel or nobody home, if Sam confirms

list.name: Dance class at a host's place (a preschool, a school, a senior center)

list.after: the saved card charged at DONE
list.note: only teachers with a background check on file; a parent stays for the whole party

pf.services.trial: one trial class per child, in a kids' class that fits the child's age and level; 2 trial spots per kids' class; checked by the parent's mobile and the child's first name
pf.services.placement: a child with training elsewhere is placed by the owner by level, not only by age: classes above level 1 ask Sam first
pf.services.packs: season tuition, class cards and recital fees are sold on the secure page with their own yes and terms, never offered in a booking text
pf.services.capacity: spots per class, set by the room (12 for kids' classes); trial spots per class; each spot is one dancer with their own check-in code; a private lesson is one teacher
pf.services.waitlist: a full class keeps a waitlist in order; a freed spot is offered by text inside text hours, to one person at a time, for 30 minutes
pf.services.minimum: a class runs only with its minimum (the owner's setting, like 4 dancers), checked a set time before (like 24 hours); Sam decides
pf.services.skills: ballet, tap, jazz, hip-hop, contemporary, ballroom and wedding dances; kids' classes and kids' parties only with teachers cleared for children
pf.services.online: kids' classes are in person; a live video private lesson for an adult counts as at the studio, with the code read out at the start
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the dancer must be there; a child's lesson at home needs a parent or guardian home the whole time

beforeTimes: who is dancing: the parent's own child, or the adult themselves
for a child: the age (it sets the age group) and the style (ballet, tap, jazz, hip-hop)
danced before? which style, and for how long (it sets the level; a trained dancer is placed by Sam)
for a private or wedding lesson: the goal, and at the studio or at home
for a class at a host's place: how many dancers, their ages, and the place
afterTime: does the dancer have the shoes the class needs? (socks are fine for a trial)
anything the teacher should know, like a first class or feeling shy
for a home lesson: the address, the room, and a clear space about 10 by 10 feet
securePage: the parent or guardian's yes that they may book for the child, and the waiver signed for the child
the child's first name and age, any health notes or allergies, and an emergency contact
the pick-up list: the adults who may take the child home
a yes or no for photos or video of the child in class
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian for anyone under 18, who books, signs and gets every text; a teen gets a link to send to a parent

stop.words: someone hurt or unwell right now: a hard fall, a head injury, an ankle they can't stand on, fainting, chest pain, trouble breathing

goOn.words: an injury that's healing, or a health condition
goOn.what: the booking goes on; the note goes on the secure page for the teacher; Rosie gives no health advice

goOn.words: a child who is shy, nervous or new to dance
goOn.what: the booking goes on; the note goes to the teacher on the secure page, who keeps a trial dancer close

pf.safety.children: a child is never alone with one adult behind a closed door; at a host's place, the host's staff stay in the room; any worry about a child's safety goes to Sam at once, and Sam reports it where the state's rules require
pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Waiver and the child's details
steps.when: before the first class, signed on the secure page while booking
steps.who: a parent or guardian signs for anyone under 18; adults sign their own
steps.goodFor: the season (1 year), or until the studio changes it
steps.result: signed: the booking goes on; not signed in 10 minutes: nothing is booked

steps.name: The pick-up list and the photo yes or no
steps.when: on the secure page while booking; the parent can change them any time
steps.result: only adults on the list take the child home; no answer to photos counts as no

steps.name: Placement for a trained dancer
steps.when: before booking a class above level 1
steps.result: Sam places the dancer by level; the trial books once he OKs

pf.first_steps.prep: for the reminder: come 10 minutes early to check in; hair back; a leotard or leggings and a T-shirt; socks or bare feet for a trial; a water bottle; for a home lesson, a clear space about 10 by 10 feet and the song you'll dance to

pf.visit.checkIn: at the studio: the parent gives the child's check-in code at the front desk, or the desk ticks names on the class roster; at a home: the code at the door; at a host's place: the host's contact gives the code
pf.visit.children: a child goes home only with an adult on the pick-up list; anyone else waits with staff while the parent is asked; for a first class or a child under 6, a parent stays in the building (the studio's setting)
pf.visit.viewing: parents watch through the lobby window; nobody else watches a kids' class without the studio's OK; photos or video of a child only with the parent's yes (a switch, on by default)
pf.visit.lateEntry: up to 15 minutes late: the dancer joins after a short warm-up; later: the dancer watches, and a trial moves to another day at no charge
pf.visit.changes: a teacher change is texted to every parent booked; 30 more minutes at a home lesson is priced and OK'd first
pf.visit.done: the check-in code or the roster tick; for a lesson away from the studio, the code or DONE from the teacher
pf.visit.note: after a trial, the teacher writes a short note on the secure page: what the child tried, how it went, and which class fits next; the parent gets a private link

pf.money.before: a trial class, an adult drop-in and a private lesson at the studio: paid in full when booking (or a YES books it and it's paid at the front desk: the owner's pick); a season: the registration fee and the first month paid in full when enrolling, then each month on the saved card; a lesson at a home: a card saved, charged at DONE; a class at a host's place: paid in full when booking
pf.money.tuition: monthly tuition is charged on the 1st to the saved card, with a text the day before; the plan's terms get their own yes; a parent can end it with 30 days' notice (the studio's setting; a longer notice or a cancel right from the state's form wins)
pf.money.caps: how far ahead a season may be charged, and any bond or account kept apart for money paid ahead: from the state's form
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel a class until 24 hours before; a lesson at a home until 7am on the lesson's day (the example owner's settings; Sam can set longer); a longer right to cancel from the state's form wins
pf.money.fees: a missed trial or a late cancel: the $15 may be kept only with Sam's OK, and no answer in 24 hours means a full refund; a home lesson cancelled late or nobody home: the $89 visit fee, only if Sam confirms
pf.money.refunds: a full refund, or a new time if the parent picks one, whenever the studio cancels or changes a class (a closed day, unsafe air, no teacher); never kept as a credit without a yes
pf.money.tax: no tax line, unless the owner sets one
pf.money.fee2: pays Rosfield's $2 for each confirmed booking

pf.messages.never: a child's last name, age, health notes, allergies, pick-up list or photos never go in a text; texts to the parent may use the child's first name only; texts to Sam or the staff carry no child details at all: they name the parent and the class, and link to the secure page
pf.messages.to: texts go only to the parent's phone, never to the child
pf.messages.minors: a teen under 18 gets a link to send to a parent; Rosie never texts the parent first
pf.messages.photos: photos or video of a child are shared only with the parent's yes, and never by text

pf.staff.skills: ballet, tap, jazz, hip-hop, contemporary, ballroom and wedding dances; Creative Movement for ages 3 to 5
pf.staff.checks: a background check on file for anyone who teaches or works with children, where the state's rules require it (a switch); a sub teaches a kids' class only with their own check on file
pf.staff.supervision: a child is never alone with one adult behind a closed door; two adults in the building for kids' classes (a teacher and the front desk: the studio's setting)
pf.staff.ratio: up to 12 dancers per teacher in a kids' class (the studio's setting; a ratio from the state's form wins)
pf.staff.whoOKs: Sam places trained dancers and OKs private lessons; Pat may OK them too
pf.staff.license: no person license for teaching dance unless the state's form names one

a waiver is a risk notice and consent; where the state's rules limit what a parent may sign for a child, the state's form sets the words
background checks for people who work with children: from the state's form
a worry about a child's safety: Sam reports it where the state's rules require
a plan that renews: its terms, 30 days' notice before a price change, and how to end it; the state's form can set more
pf.rules.photos: photos or video of a child: only with the parent's yes (on by default)

applies: the studio closes a day (unsafe air, a power cut, a storm): every parent told at once, a new time or a full refund
a teacher is out: a sub with their own background check, and parents told

a full class or no trial spot left: the waitlist, or another class that fits
a trained dancer: Sam places by level before booking
a child upset at a trial: sees the parent, then rejoins, with no pressure
a child hurt in class: first aid, the parent brought in, 911 if serious; an incident note to Sam on the secure page
someone not on the pick-up list: the child stays with staff while the parent is asked
arriving late: joins after a warm-up up to 15 minutes; later, watches, and a trial moves free
a question about the recital, costumes or shoes: the teacher's answer, passed on as written
pf.edges.generic: all others handled the generic way

ops.does: Ben's AI asks for an adult drop-in at $18, an old price. Rosie answers with the real price, $22. That's the price Ben sees before saying yes.
say: An adult drop-in at Lee Dance Studio is $22, not $18. Here are the open times at $22.
You're booked! Give this code at the front desk when you arrive.
Subject: Booked: Sat Oct 31, 2:00pm. Texts are delayed, so this comes by email. Give your check-in code at the front desk.
Subject: Rosie texts are delayed. Our texting company is down. Ben T. got his confirmation by email. Today's bookings are in the portal. We'll email again when texts work.

ops.does: Rosie checks registrations and licenses on the state's own lookup. While it's down, nothing new that needs one is checked. People already checked stay bookable.
say: The state's business lookup is down, so a new registration can't be checked yet. Bookings already open carry on. I'll tell you if it takes more than 1 business day.

more: Optional extras and tax may be shown apart.
When only the visit fee is promised, it's shown first.

more: The main story: a $15 trial class for Alex's daughter Lily, 6, who has never danced.

ops.does: Some bookings take several visits, like a series of 3 private lessons for a wedding first dance. Where the plug-in says so, all the times are picked now.
more: Each class gets its own code and its own reminder.
Rosfield's $2 counts once a month for a plan.
Alex can skip a class, or pause or end the plan, by text. Ending needs the notice in the terms.
Tuition is $95 a month, charged on the 1st, not class by class.
The plan's terms get their own yes on the secure page, before any card.

ops.does: A what-if: Alex adds Jamie, Lily's other parent, on the secure page. Jamie may change the pick-up list, sign or pay, once Jamie says yes to texts.
more: Rosie texts Jamie only once Alex adds them. Nothing about the booking goes before Jamie's yes.
Each change, signature or payment shows who gave it.
Alex can remove Jamie any time on the page.
The plug-in says what an added person may do.
No yes from Jamie: Jamie gets no texts, and only Alex may sign or pay.

ops.does: Say Alex books two adult drop-ins back to back: Adult Beginner Ballet, then Adult Hip-Hop. Rosie finds one time that fits both, and adds the prices: $22 and $22.
more: It's one booking, with one code.
If they're with two teachers, the times show both, back to back.
A child's class and a parent's class at the same hour are two bookings, each with its own code.

ops.does: This branch is for a private lesson, which books a teacher's time. Open times come from the teachers' calendars and the studio's hours, soonest first. A class books a spot (the next branch).
more: The AI passes on the answers that set the price and time. No name or street address yet.
Nobody can pay to be shown higher.
Only teachers who can teach the lesson are offered: the right style and free time.
For a child, the teacher needs a background check on file, where the switch is on.
A room must be free too.
Nora works Saturday afternoons, so Nora is offered from noon. In the morning, only as a sub.
Named-only work: no person shows until the customer names one. Then only that person's times show.

notes:
Pilot: yoga (a class studio: spots in a class, a waiver before the first class, packs and memberships, reviewed). A dance studio runs the same way, plus children: a parent books and signs, a pick-up list, trial spots, placement by level, and a season on monthly tuition. Yoga's rename pairs were the start (their right sides mapped to dance words by a script, chained pairs too), and all of yoga's ops were dropped and rewritten. Gym and martial arts were read for ideas only.
Names: Sam Lee's main company is Lee Dance Lessons LLC (private and wedding first-dance lessons at homes, classes at preschools, schools and senior centers; its second kind of work is kids' dance parties). His second company is Lee Dance Studio LLC. Studio teachers Hannah and Nora (A); teachers who travel Luis and Felix (B, both 'he'). Alex M. is the customer in both, with Alex's daughter Lily, 6 (A) and Alex's partner Jamie (B); Alex has no set pronoun. Addresses: studio 65 Linden St, main company 400 Spruce St, Alex's home 23 Hazel Rd. Registrations BR318820 and BR31907.
Flow A (main, list|full|none): Wed Oct 21 7:15pm Alex asks an AI for a trial ballet class for Lily, 6, new to dance. Ballet 1 (ages 6 to 8), Sat Oct 24 11:00am, Hannah, 12 spots and 2 trial spots, $15 paid in full on the secure page with the waiver, the child's details, the pick-up list and the photo yes or no. Code 5160 at the front desk; Alex stays in the lobby (a parent stays for a trial or a child under 6). Hannah's note goes on the secure page (A8-45) and by private link (A10-x01). Sun Oct 25 Alex enrolls Lily for the season on the note page (A10-x02 to A10-x04): $40 registration + November's $95 now, then $95 on the 1st, first class Sat Nov 7, recital yes or no by Dec 1.
Flow A's other path (list|none|counter): the same $15 trial at a studio that takes nothing online, paid at the front desk. Adults book drop-ins for themselves on the A4-24 adult branch ($22, own waiver).
Flow B (main, list|card|card): Mon Oct 19 6:40pm Alex books a wedding first-dance lesson at home for himself and Jamie; Luis comes Thu Oct 22, starts at 8:00am, 75 minutes, $179 charged to the saved card at DONE; $89 fee for a late cancel or nobody home, only if Sam confirms. Each dancer signs their own waiver. B's other path (list|full|none) is the same lesson paid in full when booking; a $150 class at a preschool, school or senior center is paid in full too (B4-46 shows the preschool class: the preschool's staff stay in the room, the business gets no child details, photos only with each parent's yes).
Money paths, from how the work is really paid: the trial, drop-ins, private lessons, the registration fee and a tuition month are paid in full (list|full|none); a studio may take nothing online and be paid at the desk (list|none|counter); lessons at a home are charged to the saved card at DONE (list|card|card) or paid in full. No holds, no deposits, no bill: a dance business doesn't work that way. Monthly tuition is drawn as a plan (A5-21, A7-32, A7-54, A7-55, A10-x03); its real monthly life is the gap 'A membership that renews each month'.
Child safety: a parent or guardian books and signs for a child (A4-24, A4-25, A4-70); the child's name, age, health notes, allergies, pick-up list and photos stay on the secure page; texts to the parent may use the first name only, and texts to Sam or staff name only the parent and the class (A6-02, A6-15, A8-01, A8-14, A8-38, A10-x04). Pick-up only by an adult on the list (A8-42). Background checks for anyone who works with children are a switch from the state's form, asked at S2-29 (the license branch S2-11 is off; no dance teacher holds a state license), renewed at S11-50, lapsing at S11-51. Photos or video of a child only with the parent's yes (A4-65). At home, a parent stays for a child's lesson (B8-67, B8-09).
State rules only as switches: selling a season ahead (bond, account kept apart, written contract, cancel right, how far ahead money is taken) is S1-54/S1-55 and pf.rules; the waiver's words where a state limits them; reporting a worry about a child. The old flowchart's one-state bond, cancel and contract rules are outdated as state rules.
Plug-in splits kept (splitsKept): A4-66 (a spot in a class, or a teacher's time for a private lesson), A7-59 and A7-61 (classes name no one; private lessons are by name; 'Nobody else, like a first dance'), A7-67 (classes have a minimum), A8-67 (a parent stays for a trial or a child under 6; enrolled dancers 6 and up may be left), S11-87 and S11-90 in A. In B every split has an off branch.
Clocks: flow A runs Wed Oct 21 to Sun Oct 25 (then Sat Nov 7 for a later text); B runs Mon Oct 19 to Thu Oct 22 (OMW 7:40am, code 7:57am, DONE 9:15am).
